items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: And then Sidney DeParis, and them three... Fletcher Henderson's band didn't have nothin' on Charlie Johnson's band.

ctx.x: And In New York... He cut everybody in New York. Everybody who thought they could play a trumpet ain't messin'... Him and Jimmy Harrison, they were the two, trombone and trumpet... They were in Charlie Johnson's band, and they're speaking(?) to him, and then Sidney DeParis, and them three... Fletcher Henderson's band didn't have nothin' on Charlie Johnson's band. But Charlie Johnson was working at Small's Paradise, and the difference was that Fletcher was down at the Roseland Ballroom. But them people was out of…
Yeah, I heard about it. I missed him. I didn't get to hear him. What about Big Green, too? Because I hear so much about him. Did you hear him?
